svg.aria-label: Picat-SAT Multi-Agent Path Finding Makespan Bottleneck Grid and Chen-AMO Encoding

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Picat 3.9#12 SAT compilation of Barták & Zhou (ICTAI′17) mapf_makespan.pi (MPL-2.0) · Spacetime reachability pruning + Chen 2-product AMO
12 agents swap rooms through single gate (4,4) ⇒ M=18 UNSAT, M=19 SAT
Spacetime Reachability Pruning (B[t, a, v] ∈ {0, 1}, t ∈ 1..M+1):
dist(start_a, v) > t−1 ∨ dist(v, goal_a) > M+1−t ⇒ B[t,a,v] = 0
Eliminates unreachable spacetime vertices before Picat compiles EO/AMO/transition clauses.
